label: D1 late in the episode, when the agent is about to choose a2
explanation: Fires only at D1, never at GO or D2. It is strongly tied to time in the episode: 99% of its activation mass falls on trials 50-99, and its rate climbs from about 1% before trial 50 to 15% at trials 90-99. This matches the low end of the value head (value < 7.13 holds 97% of the mass), which falls as the episode runs out. Within those late D1 steps it prefers trials where the agent is about to choose a2: the upcoming action is a2 for 89% of the mass, and the D1 policy logit is mildly a2-leaning (choice in [-4.4, -1.5] holds 82% of the mass). The previous trial being rewarded raises the rate (in_rew = 1 carries 74% of the mass). The recorded predicate uses the agent upcoming choice. That is marked FUTURE, but the agent computes it itself, so it is allowed. No future reward or transition is used. Observed-only alternatives score about the same: D1 & value < 7.13 & choice < -1.52 gives F1 0.65, and D1 & ep_trial >= 60 & prev_action == 2 gives F1 0.54. Late-episode D1 alone gives F1 0.52 with 0.96 mass recall. Activations are tiny in absolute terms (max 0.004), and precision stays around 0.6, so this is only a partial, graded description. The largest activations come at late-episode D1 steps right after a reward with a2 coming next. It does not fire early in the episode, on a1-favoring D1 steps (rare), or after penalty inputs.
